name: What are common signs of ceiling water damage?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of ceiling water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of ceiling water damage include discolored spots or stains, often yellow or brown. You might also notice bubbling, peeling, or flaking paint on the ceiling. Another indicator is a sagging or bowing ceiling, which suggests structural compromise. A musty or damp odor, even without visible signs, can also point to hidden moisture issues. Early detection helps prevent more extensive damage and costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of ceiling water damage include discolored stains, peeling paint, sagging, or musty odors.
